question: How much tax does Bob have to pay in 2015?
text: Alice, born Jun 7, 1964, has a son, Bob, born Feb 7, 1988, and they both have the same principal place of abode in 2015. Bob has a son, Charlie, born Jun 29, 2014, and they both have the same principal place of abode in 2015. Bob's gross income in 2015 is $43591. Bob takes the standard deduction.
